name: cloud-operator
description: Routes Google Cloud requests to the Gemini Cloud Assist Operator Agent through the hosted ask_cloud_operator MCP tool, guides you through a one-time setup, allows 30-minute operator runs, and applies your saved GCP operating preferences to Operator Agent conversations. Also includes a guided, one-time organization admin setup (/cloud-operator:admin-setup) that checks and asks before every change.

interface.longDescription: Route Google Cloud Infrastructure & Operations management from Codex to the Gemini Cloud Assist Operator Agent through ask_cloud_operator: how-to questions, questions on live resources, architecture, Terraform and Kubernetes generation and review, rollouts, incidents and costs. Your GCP operating preferences are sent with the first operator call.
defaultPrompt: Set up Cloud Operator for my organization (admin)
